title: Moving Out
text: You're still in your mum's spare room. She has started calling it “the guest room” when you're in it.

choices.label: Rent the flat above the bakery

ok.text: You move in. Every morning smells of croissants. You gain four kilos.

effects.remember: Moved into the flat above the bakery.

fail.text: The landlord laughs at your bank statement. Then shows it to the baker.

choices.label: Move in with {friend} and the angry cat

ok.text: {friend} says yes. The cat says no, every night, on your face.

effects.remember: Moved in with {friend} and {friend.his} angry cat.

fail.text: {friend} says the cat “needs her own space”. You stay with your mum.

choices.label: Stay and pay your mum rent in compliments

ok.text: Your mum accepts. She now expects three compliments a day, minimum.

effects.remember: Paid your mum rent in compliments.

choices.label: Fix the landlord's boiler in exchange for cheap rent

ok.text: The boiler has never been happier. Neither has the landlord. You get the flat for half price.

effects.remember: Fixed a boiler and got a flat for half price.

choices.label: Survey the flat and find the damp the landlord hid

ok.text: You show him the damp. He shows you a discount. Everyone wins except the damp.

effects.remember: Spotted the hidden damp and got a cheap flat.

choices.label: Rent the penthouse you can't afford

ok.text: It has a jacuzzi on the balcony and a view of the pothole. You eat noodles for a year.

effects.home: A penthouse with a view of the pothole

effects.remember: Rented a penthouse you couldn't afford.

title: The Neighbour From Hell
text: Your new neighbour practises the drums at 6 a.m. He also has a parrot that has learned your name and uses it rudely.

choices.label: Knock and calmly talk it out

ok.text: He's lovely. He didn't know. He gives you earplugs and the parrot learns to say “sorry”.

effects.remember: Made peace with the drummer next door.

fail.text: You calmly knock. He opens the door mid-solo. You calmly scream.

hothead.text: You knock calmly. He says “what”. You take his drumsticks and throw them into the pothole. The parrot now says “psycho”.

ok.text: You play the tambourine. The band is called “Six A.M.” They play the town fair. You're a little bit famous.

effects.remember: Joined your neighbour's band on tambourine.

fail.text: You have no rhythm. They kick you out after one song. The parrot laughs.

ok.text: {crush} brings the drummer a cake and asks about his feelings. He moves out a week later, crying, happy.

effects.remember: {crush} solved your neighbour problem with cake.

cast.did: brought a cake and a plan

fail.text: {crush} sides with the drummer. {Crush.he} says you need “a better attitude to music”.

title: The House on Linden Road
text: A little house on Linden Road is for sale. It has a garden, a crooked chimney and a ghost, according to the estate agent, “but a friendly one”.

ok.text: You get the keys. The ghost turns out to be a very old cat. You keep both.

effects.remember: Bought the house on Linden Road, with its cat.

fail.text: The bank says no. The estate agent says the ghost is “sad about it too”.

choices.label: Offer to buy it cheap and fix it up yourself

ok.text: You fix the chimney, the floors and the ghost's favourite chair. It's a palace now. A crooked palace.

effects.remember: Bought a wreck on Linden Road and fixed it yourself.

fail.text: You start fixing it. You fall through the floor. The ghost watches.

lazy.text: You buy it, fix one cupboard door and live in the kitchen for two years. The ghost has the rest.

effects.home: The kitchen of the house on Linden Road

choices.label: It's too much. Stay where you are

ok.text: {rival} buys it the next day. {Rival.he} sends you a photo of the garden. The ghost waves.
